about.headline: UpnaLab: Future Interactive Devices
about.subheadline: We are a research group based on the Public University of Navarre (Spain, Pamplona). We combine computer science, chemistry, electronics, optics and/or acoustics with technology to create novel interactive devices.
expertise: Sensors and actuator for HCI and Haptics

values.title: Curiosity Driven
values.description: Deep inside, curiosity is the main drive. Our reason for doing research is to see what nobody has seen before.

values.title: Pragmatic Multidisciplinarity
values.description: Computer Science, Chemistry, Electronics, Optics or Acoustics are all tools that you need to exploit to realize the most innovative ideas.

values.title: Demos and Open Science
values.description: We share how to build new devices through videos, open instructions and hands-on demonstrations.

sponsors.title: Project InteVol – Horizon Europe ERC Starting Grant 101042702 – 2022-2027

diy.title: Instructables
diy.description: Check our Instructables and guided tutorials to build your own devices. Acoustic Levitators, Ultrasonic Phased Arrays, Volumetric Displays, and more.

diy.title: YouTube Tutorials
diy.description: From basic electronics and soldering, to how to build your own Ultrasonic Levitators and Phased arrays. Follow video tutorials at your own pace on our YouTube channel.

diy.title: Open Source GitHub
diy.description: Find and keep track of the code of our Open Source projects or fork your own versions.

diy.title: UPNA's OpenSpace
diy.description: A service aimed at fostering activity-based learning, where the Public University of Navarra (UPNA) community can create and develop projects, share knowledge, and explore new technologies. 3D printers, laser cutters, materials for electronics and more at your disposal in the UPNA's library building.
